Four instances in this file's body use noun-run for the agent's sitting, none of which are a legal exception: (1) line 4, Big Idea, "Steer your long run" -- "long run" is adjective+noun, not the compound adjective "long-running"; (2) line 4, same sentence, "the run you already have tells you what to put there"; (3) line 14, "grounded in quoted moments from the run"; (4) line 34, "Where the run bears it out, it names your first check"; (5) line 69, "a long run you can send". The sibling M4 module's own writing instance notes noun-run was already swept to "session" there (see ae101--module--run-the-first-experiment.writing.json rule 21b evidence) -- this M5 file did not receive the same sweep, and the 2026-08-14 maintainer edit to lines 32-34 introduced at least one new instance ("Where the run bears it out") on top of the pre-existing ones in the Big Idea and LO. Harm is squarely present: this is the module's own opening line (Big Idea), the highest-visibility sentence in the file, using the exact term the training's controlled vocabulary singles out as the one engineers don't say.
